claim_text: Global mean surface temperature increased by 1.1°C above pre-industrial levels by 2022.

evidence_spans.span_text: The global mean surface temperature in 2022 was approximately 1.15°C above the 1850–1900 pre-industrial baseline.

claim_text: CO2 concentrations reached 421 ppm in May 2023.

evidence_spans.span_text: Atmospheric CO2 concentrations at Mauna Loa reached 421.47 ppm in May 2023, a new monthly high.

claim_text: Arctic sea ice extent declined by 13% per decade since 1979.

evidence_spans.span_text: Satellite records show Arctic sea ice extent has decreased at a rate of 13.1% per decade relative to the 1981–2010 average.

claim_text: Renewable energy provided 29% of global electricity in 2022.

evidence_spans.span_text: Renewables accounted for approximately 29% of global electricity generation in 2022 according to IEA data.

claim_text: Sea level rose by 3.7 mm per year on average between 2006 and 2018.

evidence_spans.span_text: The global mean sea level rise rate from 2006 to 2018 was 3.7 mm/year, according to satellite altimetry records.

claim_text: The Greenland ice sheet lost 280 billion tonnes of mass per year between 2002 and 2016.

evidence_spans.span_text: GRACE satellite data show the Greenland ice sheet lost approximately 280 Gt/yr of mass from 2002 to 2016.

claim_text: Ocean heat content in the upper 2000 m increased at a rate of 0.36 W/m² between 1971 and 2010.

evidence_spans.span_text: The rate of ocean heat uptake in the 0–2000 m layer was 0.36 W/m² over 1971–2010.

claim_text: Global forest area decreased by 178 million hectares from 1990 to 2020.

evidence_spans.span_text: The world lost approximately 178 million ha of forest between 1990 and 2020 per FAO data.

claim_text: The share of coal in global electricity generation fell to 36% in 2022.

evidence_spans.span_text: Coal's share of global power generation declined to 36% in 2022, down from 38% in 2020.

claim_text: Solar PV capacity additions reached 191 GW globally in 2021.

evidence_spans.span_text: Global solar photovoltaic additions totalled 191 GW in 2021, the largest single-year increase to date.

claim_text: Methane concentrations reached 1,908 ppb in 2021.

evidence_spans.span_text: Atmospheric methane concentration averaged 1,908 ppb in 2021, an increase of 18 ppb from 2020.

claim_text: The Paris Agreement was adopted by 196 parties in December 2015.

evidence_spans.span_text: The Paris Agreement was adopted at COP21 in December 2015 by 196 parties to the UNFCCC.

claim_text: EU emissions declined by 31% between 1990 and 2020.

evidence_spans.span_text: EU greenhouse gas emissions fell by approximately 31% between 1990 and 2020.

claim_text: Wind power produced 6.6% of global electricity in 2020.

evidence_spans.span_text: Wind energy contributed 6.6% of global electricity generation in 2020.

claim_text: The permafrost in Siberia stores approximately 1,500 Gt of carbon.

evidence_spans.span_text: Siberian permafrost contains an estimated 1,500 Gt of organic carbon, roughly double the current atmospheric CO2.

claim_text: Coral bleaching events doubled in frequency between 1980 and 2016.

evidence_spans.span_text: The average interval between bleaching events on reefs around the world shortened from 25–30 years in the 1980s to about 6 years by 2016.

claim_text: Carbon capture and storage projects stored less than 50 Mt CO2 in 2021.

evidence_spans.span_text: Global CCS capacity operational in 2021 captured and stored around 40 Mt CO2/year.

claim_text: India added 14 GW of renewable capacity in fiscal year 2022.

evidence_spans.span_text: India's renewable energy additions reached approximately 14 GW in FY2021-22.

claim_text: The number of climate-related natural disasters doubled between 1980 and 2020.

evidence_spans.span_text: Climate-related disasters reported globally nearly doubled from the 1980s to 2010–2020 per Munich Re data.

claim_text: Lithium-ion battery prices fell by 89% between 2010 and 2020.

evidence_spans.span_text: BloombergNEF data show lithium-ion battery pack prices dropped 89% in real terms from 2010 to 2020.

claim_text: Global EV sales exceeded 10 million units in 2022.

evidence_spans.span_text: Electric vehicle sales reached 10.5 million units globally in 2022, a 55% increase from 2021.

claim_text: The Amazon basin released more CO2 than it absorbed in the 2010s.

evidence_spans.span_text: A 2021 study found parts of the eastern Amazon emitted more CO2 than they absorbed over 2010–2018, driven by deforestation.

claim_text: Nuclear power provided about 10% of global electricity in 2022.

evidence_spans.span_text: Nuclear energy generated approximately 10% of the world's electricity in 2022.

claim_text: The 2021 IPCC report confirmed that human influence has warmed the climate.

evidence_spans.span_text: The Sixth Assessment Report (IPCC, 2021) states unequivocally that human influence has warmed the atmosphere, ocean, and land.

claim_text: Average global crop yield increases slowed after 1990 compared with 1960–1990.

evidence_spans.span_text: The rate of yield improvement for major cereals decelerated after 1990 relative to the green-revolution era.

claim_text: US shale gas production surpassed 25 trillion cubic feet in 2020.

evidence_spans.span_text: US dry shale gas production exceeded 26 tcf in 2020 according to EIA statistics.

claim_text: Deforestation in Brazil's Amazon increased by 22% in 2021.

evidence_spans.span_text: INPE data show deforestation in Brazil's Legal Amazon rose by 22% in 2021 to 13,235 km².

claim_text: Global cement production exceeded 4 billion tonnes in 2020.

evidence_spans.span_text: World cement output was approximately 4.1 billion metric tonnes in 2020.

claim_text: Average global surface temperature in 2016 was the warmest on record at the time.

evidence_spans.span_text: 2016 was the warmest year in the modern instrumental record up to that point, surpassing 2015.

claim_text: Hydropower supplied roughly 16% of global electricity in 2020.

evidence_spans.span_text: Hydropower accounted for about 16.2% of global electricity generation in 2020.

claim_text: The global mean sea level was about 100–120 mm higher in 2020 than in 1900.

evidence_spans.span_text: Sea level reconstructions indicate a rise of approximately 100–120 mm between 1900 and 2020.

claim_text: Atmospheric N2O concentration reached 333 ppb in 2020.

evidence_spans.span_text: Nitrous oxide concentration reached 333.2 ppb in 2020, the highest in at least 800,000 years.

claim_text: China is the world's largest emitter of CO2, accounting for about 30% of global emissions.

evidence_spans.span_text: China accounted for approximately 30% of global CO2 emissions in 2020.

claim_text: The global average temperature in 2021 was about 1.11°C above pre-industrial levels.

evidence_spans.span_text: 2021 was approximately 1.11°C warmer than the 1850–1900 pre-industrial baseline per WMO.

claim_text: Tropical cyclone intensity has increased globally since the 1980s.

evidence_spans.span_text: Multiple studies confirm that the proportion of tropical cyclones reaching category 4 or 5 increased between 1980 and 2010.

claim_text: More than 1 million plant and animal species are currently threatened with extinction.

evidence_spans.span_text: The IPBES 2019 Global Assessment estimated that around 1 million species face extinction in coming decades.

claim_text: Average Antarctic temperatures have risen at twice the global average rate since the 1950s.

evidence_spans.span_text: The Antarctic Peninsula has warmed at roughly twice the global average rate since the mid-20th century.

claim_text: The global land use for agriculture is approximately 50% of all habitable land.

evidence_spans.span_text: Approximately half of all habitable land on Earth is used for agriculture.

claim_text: Air pollution causes approximately 7 million premature deaths per year globally.

evidence_spans.span_text: The WHO estimates outdoor and indoor air pollution combined cause around 7 million premature deaths annually.

claim_text: Electric bus fleet in China exceeded 400,000 units by 2019.

evidence_spans.span_text: China had over 420,000 electric buses operating by the end of 2019.

claim_text: Global average CO2 price in EU ETS was approximately €50/tonne in 2021.

evidence_spans.span_text: The EU Emissions Trading System carbon price averaged around €50/tCO2 in 2021.

claim_text: Solar energy costs fell more than 90% between 2009 and 2019.

evidence_spans.span_text: The levelised cost of utility-scale solar PV dropped over 90% from 2009 to 2019.

claim_text: The Kyoto Protocol set binding emission targets for developed countries for 2008–2012.

evidence_spans.span_text: Under the Kyoto Protocol, industrialised nations committed to binding greenhouse gas reduction targets for the first commitment period 2008–2012.

claim_text: Global plastic waste generation reached 353 million tonnes in 2019.

evidence_spans.span_text: Global plastic waste amounted to approximately 353 Mt in 2019 per OECD data.

claim_text: The Sahara Desert expanded southward by approximately 10% over the 20th century.

evidence_spans.span_text: Studies indicate the Sahara expanded roughly 10% during the 20th century, primarily at its southern margins.

claim_text: Between 2000 and 2020, the world gained 0.5% more tree cover annually due to reforestation.

evidence_spans.span_text: Global reforestation and forest recovery contributed to a net gain in tree cover in certain regions, with canopy cover increasing by roughly 2.24 million km² from 1982 to 2016.

claim_text: US carbon emissions fell by 21% between 2005 and 2019.

evidence_spans.span_text: US greenhouse gas emissions declined approximately 21% from their 2005 peak to 2019.

claim_text: Germany's renewable energy share exceeded 40% of electricity consumption in 2019.

evidence_spans.span_text: Renewables provided more than 40% of Germany's gross electricity consumption in 2019.

claim_text: Global mean sea level is rising at an accelerating rate since the early 1990s.

evidence_spans.span_text: Satellite altimetry data show an acceleration in global mean sea level rise from about 2.1 mm/yr in 1993 to 3.6 mm/yr in 2008–2018.

claim_text: The ozone hole over Antarctica was the smallest on record in 2019 since the 1980s.

evidence_spans.span_text: NASA data showed the Antarctic ozone hole in 2019 was the smallest ever recorded since monitoring began in the early 1980s.

claim_text: More than 2 billion people lack access to safe drinking water.

evidence_spans.span_text: The WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme reported that 2.2 billion people lacked safely managed drinking water services in 2020.

claim_text: Wildfire burned area in California set a record in 2020 exceeding 4 million acres.

evidence_spans.span_text: California wildfires burned over 4.1 million acres in 2020, the largest in state history at that time.

claim_text: Deep-sea mining has not yet been commercially deployed at scale as of 2022.

evidence_spans.span_text: No commercial-scale deep-sea mining operations were active as of 2022; all activity remained at exploration and pilot stages.

claim_text: The 2015 Paris Agreement aims to limit warming to well below 2°C above pre-industrial levels.

evidence_spans.span_text: The Paris Agreement's long-term temperature goal is to hold warming well below 2°C and pursue efforts to limit it to 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels.

claim_text: Norway has the world's highest EV market share, exceeding 70% of new car sales in 2021.

evidence_spans.span_text: Battery electric vehicles accounted for approximately 72% of new passenger car registrations in Norway in 2021.
